_comment: Committed source-of-truth for the funroadtrip registry entry. The live feed (demo/cli-audit/latest.json) and registry.db are gitignored generated state, so this entry does NOT travel with git. Apply it on any machine with `sh fleet-clis/funroadtrip/seed/apply.sh`. Unlike pdf-tools, funroadtrip's binary lives in its OWN separate repo (~/projects/60_funroadtrip), not under fleet-clis/ -- precedented by existing entries whose path points outside this repo (generate_pdf_v2 -> 30_SVG-PAINT, generate_pdf -> 50_KETO). Path is resolved at apply time from FUNROADTRIP_REPO, not hardcoded here.

entries.description: What kid-friendly POI (playground, toilets, food, fuel, ...) is near this GPS position, within a radius or widened until N results are found. The device/agent contract: --json emits one object per hit with toilet/opening-hours/chain-vouch three-state fields, never a collapsed boolean. Read-only -- queries a local SQLite corpus of ~1.06M harvested OSM POIs, no network call. Supports --adaptive-cap: density-adaptive per-postcode capping (each category x PLZ cell keeps its ceil(sqrt(n)) nearest rows; rows without a postcode are never compressed -- DE-only in effect).
